blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock 55+ Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: This page spans two municipalities: South Surrey is part of the City of Surrey, while White Rock is its own city, so a townhome on the Surrey side follows Surrey bylaws and taxes and a townhome a few blocks away in White Rock follows White Rock's, even though both use School District No. 36 (Surrey).

The commercial and services core is the Semiahmoo Town Centre area around 152 Street and 16 Avenue in South Surrey, where the City's town centre planning has focused apartment and townhouse growth, with single-family pockets between 154 and 157 Streets and 17 and 18 Avenues debated in that plan process.

South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre at 14601 20 Avenue is the recreation anchor for the area, and White Rock Community Centre at 15154 Russell Avenue sits just across the municipal line in White Rock.

blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock 55+ Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: A named seniors residence buyers often confuse with townhome ownership is Amica White Rock at 15331 16 Avenue, which the City of Surrey describes as a seniors' residence in South Surrey in its public-art listing for the sculpture at its entrance; it is a residence, not a townhome strata you can buy.

Surrey's own seniors planning frames the stock goal as age-friendly, adaptable housing that lets people stay independent, in the City's Age Friendly Strategy and Action Plan for residents aged 55 and older.

blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock 55+ Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Town centre density is plan-led, not automatic: the Semiahmoo Town Centre process records that change there was expected to be gradual over many decades, so a townhome beside the centre faces planned growth, not instant redevelopment (plan engagement material is from 2019).

blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock 55+ Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The recreation centre itself crosses generations by design: the City describes South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre at 14601 20 Avenue as a state-of-the-art intergenerational facility with an 8,000 square foot fitness centre, a youth lounge and a therapeutic garden, with seniors services inside it, not in a separate seniors-only building.

A Mandarin-language seniors drop-in runs at that centre on the second and fourth Thursday of the month, per the City's January 2026 South Surrey newsletter, and a seniors services membership is required for it.

The White Rock and South Surrey Food Bank collection bin sits at the South Surrey recreation centre, per the City newsletter, a small sign that food-bank service for both municipalities is run locally from that hub.

Surrey's Age Friendly Action Plan is the current seniors-housing policy project, built with the Surrey Age-Friendly Network and aimed at access to suitable housing and support for independent living for residents aged 55 and older.

items.t: Surrey's 2026 residential municipal total is $1.84251 per $1,000 of assessed value, made up on the City's rate page of a general municipal total of $1.68947 plus a roads and traffic levy of $0.15304, before school, TransLink and other levies added on the same page.

blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock 55+ Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: The municipal split is itself a due-diligence item: the same street name can cross from Surrey into White Rock, changing the tax rate, garbage service and bylaw set.

faq.q: Where are seniors programs for a 55+ townhome owner?
faq.a: At South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre at 14601 20 Avenue. The City's South Surrey newsletter lists a Seniors Services membership at $30.00 per year for registered volunteer-led drop-in activities, events and clubs, plus discount pricing on select 55+ registered programs.

faq.q: Is Amica White Rock a place I can buy a townhome?
faq.a: No. Amica White Rock at 15331 16 Avenue is a seniors' residence, named as such on the City of Surrey's own page for the entrance sculpture there, so it is rental residence living near the townhome area, not strata townhome ownership.

faq.q: Will the Semiahmoo Town Centre change my street?
faq.a: Slowly, on the City's own account. Engagement material for the town centre records gradual change over many decades and strong resident concern about density, traffic and parking, so a buyer should read the current town centre plan for their block rather than assume the complex will be redeveloped soon.

faq.q: Can I rent out a 55+ unit in South Surrey White Rock?
faq.a: Whether a unit can be rented depends on the strata's current bylaws and the provincial rules that apply to them, and many 55+ buildings restrict rentals. Ask for the bylaws and the strata minutes before you buy a unit in South Surrey White Rock as an investment.

faq.q: What does 55+ mean for a home in South Surrey White Rock?
faq.a: Most 55+ strata communities in BC set an age rule in their bylaws, commonly that at least one resident is 55 or older, and many also limit children and rentals. The rules differ from one building to the next, so read the bylaws and the Form B Information Certificate before you make an offer on a unit in South Surrey White Rock.
